scope: Complete construction, testing, flushing and disinfection of one explicitly designed settlement water-supply network: 1200 m of selected PE100-RC SDR17 OD 160 PN10 pressure pipe. Pipe-system materials, trench quantities, valves, hydrants, chambers, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved water-supply design organization, geotechnical engineer, pressure-pipe manufacturer, accredited water laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved pressure-pipe material, grade, SDR, diameter and pressure-class schedule
approved trench, bedding, surround, backfill and excess-soil quantities
approved joints, fittings, valves, hydrants, chambers and cover schedule
installation and jointing method with labor and mechanism quantities
pressure-testing, flushing, disinfection and laboratory-control program
conditional crossing-casing, dewatering and road-restoration schedules
supplier pipe-segment length and approved retained spare length

rules.totalNeed: installed net length + retained spare length

forbiddenClaims: trench or material quantities derived from generic length coefficients
automatic valve, hydrant, fitting or chamber spacing
automatic casing, dewatering or road restoration
universal pipe spare or supplier segment length
building plumbing or sewer and stormwater networks included
